training_setup.optimizer: SGD, momentum 0.9 (Nesterov), weight decay 5e-4, bf16 autocast
training_setup.learning_rate_schedule: linear warmup to 0.1 over 1 epoch, then per-step cosine decay to 0
training_setup.augmentation: random 32x32 crop from 4px zero-padded image + random horizontal flip
training_setup.gpu_used: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU (6 GB)

task3.method: mean of rank-normalised (a) 1 - cross-validated softmax prob of the noisy label (4-fold CV, 20 epochs per fold, mean of last 5 epochs) and (b) per-sample CE loss averaged over all 60 epochs of the Task 1 noisy CE run
